title: Lemma 2.13: the augmented diagram over the slice is a p-colimit
statement_scope: Let T be a pregeometry, X an infinity-topos, O an object of Str^loc_T(X) with underlying object final in X, and E as in Lemma 2.12. Then the induced functor E^> -> Str^loc_T(X) exhibits Str^loc_T(X) as a p-colimit of the restricted diagram; equivalently, for every X in X the associated augmented diagram of fibers is a colimit diagram, the assertion reducing to claim (*) after base change along X -> 1 and using a left cofinal section.
